texts.cardDescription: Public access through a Cloudflare Tunnel, with no port forwarding.
texts.aboutTunnelSettings: The tunnel token comes from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard. The public hostname is the address visitors use to reach this installation.
texts.confirmRemove: This stops the tunnel and clears the stored token and public hostname. You will need to configure it again to use Cloudflare Tunnel.
